dedupe_keys.name: solanum potato production simulation model international potato center

description: SOLANUM is a user-friendly crop growth model from the International Potato Center that simulates tuber dry mass accumulation for different potato species, varieties and hybrids, and estimates tuber yield under potential, water-limited and frost-limited conditions. The CIP Dataverse page lists software version 3.05 as one RAR archive of about 7.6 MB, with authors Bruno Condori, Roberto Quiroz, Carolina Barreda, Carla Gavilan, Jose Guerrero and Javier Osorio, and AGROVOC keywords crop model and yield prediction. It was issued in 2017, with the current dataset version 2 released on 23 March 2020, downloadable and free under CC0 1.0. Coverage is any potato-growing site with weather inputs; the operating system, inputs and calibration regions are not stated on the page read. Caveats: it is a single-crop model and pest and disease losses are not mentioned. For simulation it estimates how drought and frost hit potato yields, useful for climate adaptation and food security scenarios. Related catalogue records include SWEETPO, DSSAT and APSIM.
name: SOLANUM - potato production simulation model (International Potato Center)
outputs: tuber dry mass and yield under potential
